name: Holzerhof
beschreibung: The Holzerhof is located in a rural area of Tirol, away from busy roads. The accommodation operates as an inn and offers simple but clean guest rooms for overnight stays. Amenities include a restaurant with regional cuisine as well as parking for guests. The surroundings are characterized by mountain scenery and farmland, making them suitable for walks. Guests can expect a quiet atmosphere and closeness to nature, but not luxurious comfort.
